Package threepl.parser

Class SrcLoc

java.lang.Object
threepl.parser.SrcLoc
public class SrcLoc extends Object
A class containing token location information. The file reader SrcReader inserts file name token strings at the start of any input file and before the first line when reverting from an included file back to the including file. These tokens contain the file name and line number. The parser extracts this information and skips the tokens. The newline token is also skipped by the parser, but the line counter is incremented. The file name, line number and column number are copied into every token. Each tree node when constructed contains a field of this class. The location is that of the most relevant associated token.

    • SrcLoc

      public SrcLoc(Token t)
      Construct a source location using the information from a token. Note that because input files have been switched back and forth as include files have been encountered the Token fields beginLine and endLine are wrong. Field lineNo should be used instead (this assumes that the token does not extend over more than one line, but for this compiler that is true except for comments, which we skip anyway)
      Parameters:
      t - a parser token
